test -n "$node1_ip" && test -n "$node2_ip" && test -n "$node3_ip" && test -n "$node4_ip"

cat > /etc/thanos/objstore.yml <<EOF
type: S3
config:
  bucket: thanos-metrics
  endpoint: $node4_ip:9000
  access_key: $AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID
  secret_key: [REDACTED]
  insecure: false
EOF
chown root:prometheus /etc/thanos/objstore.yml
chmod 0640 /etc/thanos/objstore.yml
cat > /etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml <<EOF
global:
  scrape_interval: 5s
  scrape_timeout: 4s
  evaluation_interval: 5s
  external_labels:
    cluster: antrieb-ha
    replica: $NODE_NAME
scrape_configs:
  - job_name: prometheus
    static_configs:
      - targets:
          - $node1_ip:9090
          - $node2_ip:9090
  - job_name: node
    static_configs:
      - targets: ['$node1_ip:9100']
        labels:
          node: node1
      - targets: ['$node2_ip:9100']
        labels:
          node: node2
      - targets: ['$node3_ip:9100']
        labels:
          node: node3
      - targets: ['$node4_ip:9100']
        labels:

/usr/bin/promtool check config /etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml

Restart=always
RestartSec=3
EOF
install -d -m 0750 -o prometheus -g prometheus /var/lib/prometheus/metrics2
cat > /etc/systemd/system/thanos-sidecar.service <<EOF
[Unit]
Description=Thanos Sidecar for $NODE_NAME
Wants=network-online.target
After=network-online.target prometheus.service
Requires=prometheus.service
[Service]
User=prometheus
Group=prometheus
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/thanos sidecar --http-address=$NODE_IP:10902 --grpc-address=$NODE_IP:10901 --prometheus.url=http://$NODE_IP:9090 --tsdb.path=/var/lib/prometheus/metrics2 --objstore.config-file=/etc/thanos/objstore.yml
Restart=always
RestartSec=3
NoNewPrivileges=true
PrivateTmp=true
ProtectSystem=full
ProtectHome=true
ReadWritePaths=/var/lib/prometheus/metrics2
[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
EOF
